title: Blind Corners
tagline: Fire beams into a dark box and work out where its mirrors hide
description: A daily deduction puzzle: three new boxes every day, the same for everyone. A dark box hides a few mirrors. Fire a beam of light in from any edge and you learn one thing only: where it comes out. Every mirror it met on the way turned it around a corner you could not see. Mark where the mirrors must be, watch the beam run through your marks, and check when every beam is explained. Each beam costs a point, so find the mirrors in as few as the par, then share your result without spoiling the box. Missed a day? Every earlier day stays playable.
instructions: The game opens on today's Easy box. The tabs above it, or the keys 1, 2 and 3, switch between Easy, Medium and Hard.
Tap an arrow on the edge of the box to fire a beam in. It turns at every hidden mirror it meets, and the box shows only where it comes out: both ends get the same number and colour.
Tap a square inside the box to mark a mirror: one tap for a slash, two for a backslash, three to clear it. Marks are free.
The line on the box is the selected beam running through your marks. A port with a dashed red edge belongs to a beam your marks do not explain yet.

Press Check (or K) once every beam is explained. If the mirrors are wrong, the box fires a beam that proves it, and that costs 2. Any layout that no beam could tell from the hidden one counts as solved.
Every beam costs 1. Spend no more than the par, which is what the portal's own solver needed, for a star.
With a keyboard: arrows or WASD move the cursor, Space fires from a port or marks a square, slash and backslash place a mirror, X clears your marks.
Not sure yet? Shift-Space, a right click, or a long press pencils a dashed, ungraded guess on a square — confirming it, or clearing it, works the same way.
Press Share (or C) to copy a spoiler-free result, and come back after midnight for the next three.
Missed a day? The arrows beside the day on the title screen (or the comma and period keys) open every earlier day. Those do not count toward your streak.
